covered:
LENS: the views of the set pieces and the game layer, at commit 2940233 (detached; the repository was not edited, `git status` is clean; /home/user/I99 not touched). Everything I wrote is in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-views (probes, logs under /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-views/logs, 83 pictures under /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-views/shots).

READ. docs/CLAUDE.md; GDD 1 to 2, 4 to 6.5, 10, 13, 15 to 18; DECISIONS D-001 to D-016, D-038, D-039, D-045 to D-050. Every line of src/view/set_piece_view.gd, gust_view.gd, sky_view.gd, cabin_view.gd, hand_view.gd, road_view.gd, vehicle_view.gd, debug_hud.gd, placeholder_factory.gd, pointer_view.gd, stop_view.gd; src/game/drive_controller.gd, stand_in_bot.gd, game.gd, audio.gd, events.gd, lines.gd; tools/smoke_all.gd, tests/support/smoke.gd, tools/check.sh; shaders/world_bend.gdshader; src/core/boss_sim.gd and car_sim.gd whole; in drive_sim.gd step(), snapshot() and its helpers, the set-piece, Suspicion, Wreck and capture/restore parts; data/anchors.json, the bosses of legs.json, the road_view group of tuning.json, lines_en.csv (all), lines_ar.csv (same ids, same order), the 28 placeholder entries the commit added.

RAN. A probe is run as: godot --headless --path <worktree> --script /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-views/runner.gd -- <probe.gd> (the runner waits for the autoloads, so a probe can name view classes that use Lines). Scene probes (scene_probe.gd, count_probe.gd, wreck_save_probe.gd in the same folder) load the real drive.tscn and drive it through the Input singleton.
- Headless with the stand-in, 60 fps: checkpoint passes at 62.0 s, ends 72.8 s; checkpoint,thorough 64.0 / 74.9 s; checkpoint,long_queue 85.8 / 96.6 s (par 90); storm, storm,crosswind, storm,night_storm all 72.0 s exactly (par 100: it never slows); dawn, dawn,market_day, dawn,early_sun all 144.5 s (par 120; boxed in at 60 km/h for the last 45 s), the Call rings out every time; arrival 27.3 s. Suspicion 0 at every Checkpoint. `--give=arak_flask,forged_papers`: searched at 80, the flask taken. `--give=window_switch`: passes. `--leg=patrol,2` three rounds: never pulled over.
- Whole Tellings, `--table=drivers --bot=line`, seeds 1, 2, 3, 5 (80,000 to 90,000 frames each): every set piece passed, no Wreck, never turned back, no hit at all (seed 3 stretch by stretch in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-views/probe_telling_3.out); it arrives at 06:42, 06:31, 05:35 and 06:23: late in three of four, because it takes every Exit; the true ending is always lost.
- Wrong arguments: unknown boss and a modifier of another boss each print one error and go on (exit 0).
- Pictures as D-015 says (1280x720, 15 fps): the Checkpoint through all phases (thorough, long queue), the Storm thin, thick, at a gust's tell and across a change (day and night storm), Dawn in all phases with the sign, barriers, soldier and the Call, Early sun, the Arrival, the whole Telling of seed 3 at 15 moments, and my own driver at the bar, on the shoulder, standing in the dust, in the bay, answering the Call, and at 75 Suspicion.
WHAT HELD (checked, no finding): looking does not change the simulation (probe_pure.gd: state hash identical with and without snapshot() and all views every tick, in Checkpoint, Storm, Dawn, Arrival and 420 s of a Telling); nothing is rebuilt each frame or leaked (count_probe.gd: 0 orphan nodes, resources constant at 50, node count rises only with the vehicle, hazard and sign pools to their high-water mark over six Checkpoint rounds and a whole Telling); no frame-rate dependence (identical event times at 15, 30 and 60 fps); every snapshot key is read with its type (no script error in 37 runs); every placeholder id used is in the registry; every line id exists in both files; barriers inside the lanes are drawn where the simulation's walls are; the lights in the mirror and the horn come together; save at the boss stop and `--continue` go on identically; a Wreck inside the Checkpoint of a Telling clears barriers, bars and soldier after the 3 s cut; the soldier's sign is inside the windscreen with eyes forward.
NOT FINDINGS, BY MILESTONE (M10): nothing listens to line_requested, so the ring's line, the tap on the glass and 'he shakes his head' are not shown yet; Audio plays nothing; Glare, Haze and lids are numbers on the HUD only (the sun is a disc with no wash, Haze 0.60 changes nothing on screen).
UNVERIFIED / COULD NOT CHECK: the Forward+ renderer and 1080p (pictures are gl_compatibility at 720p, so sizes in pixels are 1.5 times larger at 1080p); performance; anything audible; Focus slowing the road while a gust's streaks or the bars move (read only: both use road time or delta correctly); an ordinary phone call ringing together with Noor's (the snapshot's `caller` then names only Noor); the lowered visor against the sun's disc (the disc sits 5 degrees up, below the visor's top 15%); a passenger holding the phone (M8); the mirrored cabin setting; lanes 0 and 2 at the Checkpoint in pictures (the soldier and sign are placed relative to the car, so only read). I did not run the test suite (another lens).

findings.title: The Checkpoint's bar is drawn raised while the simulation's bar stops him: following the car ahead costs a lamp and +25 Suspicion
findings.where: src/view/set_piece_view.gd:213-226 (_show_bars raises up[_lane_of(x)] for a waved-on vehicle in any lane, his own included, until its tail is clear_m past the bar, then lowers it at checkpoint_bar_speed); src/core/boss_sim.gd:541-546 (the bar holds him whenever not released)
findings.gdd: D-050: 'His own goes up when he is let through; another lane's is up while a vehicle that was waved on drives under it.' D-048: 'The bar holds the car ... until he is let through; met at more than 5 km/h it is a barrier touch.' GDD 10.2: 'Touching a barrier is a scrape and +25 Suspicion'. GDD 2.2 pillar 4: 'Never random at the wheel.'
findings.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-views/probe_bar.gd (the real SetPieceView fed the snapshot 60 times a second; Checkpoint seed 1, middle lane; the car brakes only behind traffic and follows the last vehicle of its lane when it is waved on). Printed: 'reaction 0.0 s ... t=47.04 THE BAR STOPS HIM at 22.1 km/h (was 22.4): drawn bar of his lane at 68.0 deg of 80 (0 is down); released=false; tail of the waved-on vehicle 4.80 m past the bar; Suspicion 25, lamps 1' with events hit kind 1 and lamp_lit cracked_windscreen; 'reaction 0.5 s': stopped at 25.2 km/h with the bar drawn at 58.0 deg; only with 1.0 s of waiting is it down (0.0 deg). Same in the real scene (scene_probe.gd, scenario bar): /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-views/shots/probe_bar_2_rolling_to_the_bar.png (19 km/h, all three bars up, Suspicion 0, Lamps 0) and /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-views/shots/probe_bar_3_stopped_by_the_bar.png (0 km/h, 'Lamps 1 of 5 cracked_windscreen', 'Suspicion 25', his bar still tilted up).
findings.failure: The ordinary move in stop-and-go, rolling forward when the car ahead drives off under the raised bar, runs him into a bar he is shown as open: a scrape, a lamp (a fault for the rest of the Telling), +10 Nerves and half of the 50 Suspicion he may have, before the soldier has started toward him. The stand-in never shows it because it brakes for boss.bar_at itself.
findings.fix: In _show_bars keep a lane's bar up only while the waved-on vehicle is under it (ahead - half < to_bar, no '+ _clear' behind it) and bring his own lane's bar down at once (or raise checkpoint_bar_speed in tuning.json so it is down within about 0.25 s, before a nose 1.5 m behind the tail can reach it).

findings.title: Most tells of M7 have one channel and two have none (GDD 17.2)
findings.where: src/core/drive_sim.gd:643-655 (gust tell and dust change: no event), 941-960 (_report_soldier: the Stow, the sign and the delay ask for no sound; the tap is a line only), 865-880 (the bay: no event); src/view/gust_view.gd; src/view/set_piece_view.gd
findings.gdd: GDD 17.2: 'Every tell has both a sound and a visual.' GDD 2.2 pillar 4: 'Every hazard, impairment and heckle has a tell at least 1 s ahead.' (D-046 calls the dust's rhythm its own tell; D-050 applies 17.2 to the Call's ring only.)
findings.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-views/probe_tells.gd (the real StandInBot; every event printed beside changes of the snapshot's tell keys; output in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-views/probe_tells.out). Storm: gust tells begin at 8.01, 17.02, 26.01 s with no event; dust thick at 8.00 and 28.00 s, thin at 20.00 s with no event; the only sounds asked for are the horn behind him (52.30 s, with 'behind him false -> true') and a yawn. Checkpoint, thorough: phase 1 -> 2 at 47.33 s no event; 57.32 s line_requested soldier.window and no sound; wanted registration -> id at 62.00 s no event; bar up at 64.04 s no sound; 'events in all' holds no sfx_requested. Dawn: sun up 45.00 s, full 47.17 s, no event; the Call at 94.54 s: call_started, sfx phone_ring and line call.noor.rings. Arrival: in bay at 27.10 s, no event. So: gust = streaks only; the dust's change = neither (only the HUD reads dust_change_in; pictures storm_299.png and storm_302.png in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-views/shots show 15 m to 40 m in one frame); what comes up behind him = horn and mirror lights (both); the soldier's coming = his walk only; his sign = text only; his tap on the glass = a line only, nothing drawn; the bar = sight only; the ring = both; the sun = a disc only; the bay = paint only.
findings.failure: A player who sees poorly gets no warning of a gust (2 to 3 m/s of push), of the dust wall, of the document asked for, of the bar or of the bay. A deaf player loses nothing once M10 draws the lines. A colour-blind player is weakest on the red tail lights (2 to 5 px on tan) and the Patrol's blue at low Suspicion; the documents differ by place, not only by colour. In the day Storm run by itself the streaks are 1.25:1 against the dust (measured in storm_128.png: (217,201,163) on (199,179,138)); in a Telling at night 3.78:1.
findings.fix: Ask for a sound wherever the tell is only seen: sfx_requested when leg.gust_tell begins (with its side), when a sign goes up, at the tap, when the bar moves, and a wind bed while the dust is thick, with their ids added to sfx.json; ease the fog between 40 m and 15 m over the last second of dust_change_in; record in DECISIONS what is silent on purpose.
